text: At its meeting of June 5, 2018, the Human Resources, Compensation and Labour Relations Committee considered the report (June 1, 2018) from the Director of Production, Civic Theatres Toronto on Toronto Centre for the Arts – IATSE Local 58 Collective Agreement

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Approved the collective bargaining agreement between IATSE Local 58 and Civic Theatres Toronto at the Toronto Centre for the Arts, all as more particularly noted in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 1, 2018) from the Director of Production, Civic Theatres Toronto. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 1, 2018) from the Director of Production, Civic Theatres Toronto remain confidential as it pertains to labour relations or employee negotiations.
